labels: A lapelled school jacket lies over a collared shirt and centered tie, while two separate tailored trouser legs continue below the jacket hem.; 라펠 교복 재킷 아래에 깃 셔츠와 중앙 타이가 겹치고 재킷 밑단 아래로 재단된 바지의 두 다리통이 따로 이어진다.
definition: Complete optional school-life visual realization: A lapelled school jacket lies over a collared shirt and centered tie, while two separate tailored trouser legs continue below the jacket hem.
